translation.name: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau
translation.englishName: Kilivila: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau Bible

content: Komwaidosi guyousi mina Amora mapilana opilikwaibwaga mapilana Yoridani, tuvaila komwaidosi guyousi mina Kenani metoyasi mapilana Bolita Kwaiveka ilagaisi Guyau eivigaki sopi imada wa Waya Yoridani igauga komwaidosi mina Isireli eivalaguvasi, e matausina gweguya bogwa ikokolasi e si tuvaluwa itamwau paila wala mina Isireli.
Oluvi Guyau iluki Yosuwa, kawala, “Kububuli kaivila memetu e kubobu tauwau
Mapaila Yosuwa ivagi makawala Guyau bogwa eikaraiwogi, ibobu tauwau mina Isireli makwaina valu yagala Koyala Bobu.

Avai tuta mina Isireli eisilavaisi Itipita, komwaidosi tauwau tobobobu wala. Mitaga olopola kweluwovasi taitu tomota eiwowausi oviloupakala, e gala guditala pwapwawa tauwau ibobwaisi. Tuvaila, bogwa leima kala vigimkovila tuta matutona, e komwaidosi tauwau matausina kasi boda tokwabilia tutala eisilavaisi Itipita bogwa goli eikaligasi, paila eikoulovaisi Guyau. E makawala goli Guyau bogwa eikatotila saina peula, gala itagwala bigisaisi makubilana kubilumalala avaka bogwa eikatotila baisa tubusia omitibogwa.
Litusia tokwabilia matausina gala wala eibobwaisi omitibogwa, e mauula matubona tubwa Yosuwa ibobu matausina.
Avai tuta bobu bogwa leiwokuva, viloumwaidona wala isitotaulasi wala igauga ibwainasi kasi tatavi.
E Guyau ikaibiga baisa Yosuwa, “Ka, lagaila bogwa lakau kami mmosila avai tuta lokuulasi mapilana Itipita.” Baisa uula idokaisi makatupona valu yagala Giligali,
Mina Isireli igau wala isisuaisi mapilana Giligali okabayatila katitaikinela Yeriko, e tubukona minana wala kala yam kweluwotala kwaivasi koyavila ivagaisi Luvapela Pakala.
Eiyam eivitouulasi kamkwam kalagila Kenani baisa kwegubugabu waituna deli beredi gala deli kala yisi.
E mana gala tuvaila ididebwali, e mina Isireli gala tuvaila ibanaisi. Metoya makwaina tuta ikamsi kalagila Kenani.
Yosuwa kasitaiyu tau deli la puluta

Avai tuta Yosuwa bogwa eivakatitaikina Yeriko, e nanakwa igisi taitala tau itotu omatala, e kaitala puluta oyamala eiyosi. Yosuwa ilokaia matauna e ikatupoi, kawala, “Availa yoku? Taitala ma tokwabiliasi, kaina yoku taitala tilaula?”

Tau matauna ikaibiga, kawala, “Gala. Mitaga yeigu lasisu baisa paila Guyau la tokwabilia si kumatoula yeigu.” Yosuwa ikapusi opwaipwaia itemmali, e ilivala, kawala, “Yeigu m touwata. Avaka magim bavagi?”
E matauna Guyau la tokwabilia si kumatoula iluki matauna, “Kuvilili katubukolela kaikem kuligaim. Paila makwaina pwaipwaia lokutitoki kwebumaboma.” E Yosuwa ivagi makawala kala karaiwaga.

footnotes.text: Maigana Giligali kala lega makawala mina Iberu si biga “eikau”.
